youtube.title: Napoleon renamed his wife. Her real name was Rose 🌹 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Napoleon Bonaparte didn't like his wife's name… so he changed it 🌹

Rose or Josephine? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: Napoleon's wife was born Marie-Josèphe-Rose Tascher de La Pagerie and everyone called her Rose. Napoleon started calling her "Joséphine" instead, and the name stuck. He had already changed his own name too: he was born Napoleone di Buonaparte and Frenchified it to Napoléon Bonaparte.
